healthTipsListArray: "Ensure you drink enough water and avoid excessive caffeine consumption before bed to keep your heart rhythm stable."
"Do light physical activities like walking for 30 minutes every day to maintain your cardiovascular health."
"Manage stress well through relaxation techniques, deep breathing, or meditation to ease your heart's workload."
"Increase consumption of vegetables, fruits, and whole grains which are rich in fiber and good for blood circulation."
"Getting enough sleep for 7-8 hours every night is very important to give your heart time to rest."
"Reduce your daily salt intake to help keep your blood pressure within normal limits."
"Avoid smoking and secondhand smoke, as it is highly risky in triggering heart rhythm disorders."
"Limit processed foods and fast foods that are high in trans fats and cholesterol."
"Take time to relax every day. Chronic stress can affect your blood pressure and heart rate."
"Maintain your ideal body weight. Excess body weight makes your heart work harder."
"Pay attention to signs of extreme fatigue. Don't hesitate to rest if your body asks for it."
"Choose healthy protein sources like fish, skinless chicken, or nuts over fatty red meats."
"Reduce sugary and carbonated drinks. Replace them with fresh mineral water to maintain body metabolism."
"Do light stretching every morning to improve blood circulation before starting your activities."
"Laughter is good medicine! Fun activities can lower stress hormones and are good for the heart."
"Don't ignore your medication schedule. Consistency is very important in medical treatment."
"Know your body's limits. Exercise is good, but don't push yourself to excessive fatigue."
"Reduce alcohol consumption, as it can increase blood pressure and trigger arrhythmias."
"Have dinner earlier and avoid large portions before bed so your body can rest well."
"Stay positive. Emotional health is closely linked to physical health, especially the heart."

qrSync.title: Sync QR
qrSync.desc: Show this code to your doctor to start monitoring.
qrSync.step1Desc: Ask your doctor to open the ECG Rhythmia app and navigate to the Add Patient menu.
qrSync.step2Desc: Point the doctor's device camera at the QR code displayed on the left of your screen.
qrSync.step3Desc: Once successful, your heart rate data will be instantly connected in real-time.
qrSync.encryptedDesc: Your medical records are securely encrypted and can only be accessed by your doctor.

history.title: Your Examination History
history.desc: Summary of your self-monitoring heart sessions.
history.detailDesc: Historical review of your heart rate and predictive AI analysis.
history.normalDesc: Based on your ECG recording analysis, your heart rate and rhythm are monitored as
history.normalDesc2: . No signs of arrhythmia or heart rhythm disorders detected in this session.
history.normalTip: Keep maintaining a healthy lifestyle, eating nutritious foods, and exercising regularly to maintain this prime condition!
history.anomalyDesc1: Our system detected an indication of
history.anomalyDesc2: in this recording. Generally, indications like this can be marked by irregular heartbeat, palpitations, dizziness, or fatigue.
history.anomalyTip: Please stay calm, this result is an early detection. We strongly recommend that you consult a doctor immediately for further medical examination.
